genericProblem: A UI draft can invent visible actions or physical surfaces when it starts from a generic technical state instead of the original business task, formal UI standard, corresponding heritage page and interaction evidence.
rootCauseClass: The interaction author treated a platform-workspace context as a generic management pattern and did not reconcile list-detail-action design rules against the all-v2 page source and L2 acceptance evidence before drawing the wireframe.
searchedSurfaces: all IA02 PLATFORM-WORKSPACE screen declarations, wireframes and visible-operation tables
all-v2 platform-admin list, detail Drawer, form Drawer, initialization Drawer, overview, shell and L2 tests
all-v2 formal administration list-detail-action standard and element ledger
searchQueries: IA02-PLATFORM-WORKSPACE|选择为当前空间|返回集团空间管理|更换当前空间|数据总览
操作列|行尾操作|业务名称链接|详情 Drawer|页头新建
counterexamples: The v2 management table has no action column: the business-name link is the sole row entry and opens the detail Drawer.
The v2 detail Drawer closes before it opens the contextual edit Drawer, status confirmation Modal or commercial-group initialization Drawer.
The v2 overview is read-only except refresh/retry and its no-selection Result has no navigation button.

The formal v2 element ledger says Header for the workspace selector while current v2 source and L2 evidence place it in the side-menu footer; that conflict cannot be silently resolved by the IA author.

findings.evidence: The IA02 management table drew selection, view/edit and enable/disable row actions; the overview drew return/change buttons; the no-selection result drew a navigation button. Reopened all-v2 source, L2 and formal list-detail-action standard contradict every one of those additions.
